subject.title: fix(matrix): reverse-proxy path support for Matrix homeserver URLs

question: Should Matrix homeserver URL path components be treated as meaningful reverse-proxy base paths for OpenClaw helper requests on upgrade?
rationale: The code path is focused and tested, but changing a persisted homeserver URL path from ignored to meaningful is a Matrix compatibility contract that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Accept path-valued homeserver semantics
options.body: Matrix owners explicitly accept that configured homeserver path components should be preserved for helper requests, letting this PR proceed after normal merge checks.

options.title: Require broader live Matrix proof
options.body: Maintainers ask for a redacted send/receive, media, or directory round trip through the path-prefixed proxy before accepting the channel-level risk.

options.title: Pause for config contract redesign
options.body: If path-bearing homeserver URLs need a different product contract, pause this PR until the Matrix config behavior is documented and implemented.

recommendation.title: Accept path-valued homeserver semantics
recommendation.body: Matrix owners explicitly accept that configured homeserver path components should be preserved for helper requests, letting this PR proceed after normal merge checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available routing owner because CONTRIBUTING.md lists Matrix in their areas and recent history ties them to Matrix transport/config behavior.
